formula: raw per-pixel validation mean plus 3 population standard deviations

mvtec_ad2.access_caveat: The dataset page requires its download form and prohibits commercial dataset use; no dataset body is stored or redistributed by this repository.

mvtec_ad2_public_code_utils.official_page_locator: MVTec AD 2 dataset page, Code Utils for Development
mvtec_ad2_public_code_utils.role: submission structure/content checker, dataset helper, and runtime/memory snippets; not a public AD 2 metric evaluator
mvtec_ad2_public_code_utils.license_caveat: The archive carries its own license text. This repository records only source identity and does not redistribute the archive; check the supplied terms before reuse.

mvtec_ad_evaluator_v1.official_page_locator: MVTec AD dataset page, Evaluation Code
mvtec_ad_evaluator_v1.local_au_pro_0_05_basis: The archive README and CLI expose pro_integration_limit, whose accepted range includes 0.05; the evaluator integrates and normalizes the local PRO curve at that limit.
mvtec_ad_evaluator_v1.scope_limit: This is an MVTec AD local evaluator. Equivalence to the MVTec AD 2 evaluation server is unverified.
mvtec_ad_evaluator_v1.license_caveat: The archive carries a BSD-style license notice. This repository records only source identity and does not redistribute the archive.

comparator_limitation: The MVTec AD 2 paper's supplementary wording says a pixel 'exceeds' the threshold, but no public official AD 2 evaluator or equality-behavior test specifies > versus >=. That wording is suggestive, not executable comparator evidence.
contact_needed: Obtain an official evaluator or written comparator confirmation before binarization/audit/benchmark claims.
